findings.title: Floating-point rounding error in deposit calculation
findings.body: `Math.round(share)` on line 11 rounds a floating-point value, so `share` may be inexact due to binary floating-point representation. This can cause the final cents to be off by one when `toCents` is applied. Use integer arithmetic or a fixed-point library to avoid rounding errors.

findings.title: Percent parameter lacks validation
findings.body: The `percent` parameter is used directly without checking whether it is between 0 and 100. Negative or >100 values will produce nonsensical results. Validate the input to ensure it is within the expected range.

summary.problem: The new deposit calculation introduces floating-point rounding errors and lacks input validation.
summary.done_well: The helper functions `totalCents` and `toCents` are reused, keeping the code concise and consistent with the rest of the codebase.
